text: Assess the current AI and analytics maturity of all five business units (Ports, Freight, Warehousing, Customs Brokerage, Corporate Services).
Identify at least 20 AI use cases and prioritise them by business value and feasibility, with an estimated financial impact for each.
Assess the readiness of the group's data infrastructure AND its data governance (data ownership, data quality standards and data policies).
Benchmark the group's AI maturity against at least three regional and global logistics peers.
Design an AI target operating model, including an AI Centre of Excellence, key roles and decision rights.
Develop a Responsible AI framework aligned with the UAE's national AI ethics principles.
Design a change management and AI upskilling programme reaching approximately 500 employees.
Deliver two proof-of-concept pilots for top-priority use cases.
A three-year AI roadmap including investment estimates by year.
A final presentation to the Executive Board.
All final deliverables provided in both Arabic and English.
Complete the full engagement within 16 weeks.
Hold an interim Steering Committee review at week 8.
Mobilise the team and hold the project kick-off within two weeks of contract signature.
Provide CVs of the proposed team, including at least two Arabic-speaking consultants.
Provide fixed-fee pricing broken down by project phase.
